topic: Sky Sports News report on Manchester United's January transfer plans under Pochettino (Transfer Show)
hero: Sky Sports reporter outside Old Trafford (unidentified man in black hoodie) and Sky studio panel
hook: Wide studio shot of Sky Sports Transfer Show desk with Man United graphic behind
reaction_overlays: none; Sky studio backdrop with Man Utd crest and Pochettino portrait, yellow 'LIVE' wipe
transition_summary: One studio opener, yellow LIVE wipe, then one long static piece-to-camera; ~0 cuts per 10 s after opener
audio_note: reporter speaking to camera, no music (broadcast report)

reuse_segments.what: Sky Sports studio opener and reporter piece
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: needs Sky licence; recreate with own narrated graphics and a licensed Old Trafford exterior
